links.outcome: Reasonableness of AI glucose-lowering strategies by case complexity, including medication contraindications
links.effect: Mean scores fell from 89.90 ± 2.936 (simple, A-level) to 76.12 ± 11.93 (complex, C-level) (p <.0020); ChatGPT-4o 82.24 vs attending physicians 86.35 (p = .0467).
links.quote: However, its accuracy in complex cases, especially concerning medication contraindications, requires improvement.

screen.reason: The study evaluated ChatGPT-4o's performance on medical qualification exams and compared its glucose-lowering management plans on 30 real-world diabetes vignettes against general practitioners and endocrinologists using expert scoring, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
